You may also get fluids through a tube, or IV, in your arm to keep you from getting dehydrated.

related_questions.question: What is Lenox Hill Hospital ranked?

text_blocks.snippet: Lenox Hill Hospital is consistently ranked among the best hospitals in the nation and in New York City. It is recognized for its high-quality care and superior outcomes, particularly in specialties like cardiology, orthopedics, and neurosurgery.

list.title: Healthgrades:
list.snippet: Ranked among the top 1% of hospitals nationwide for overall excellence in care and superior outcomes. It's the only hospital in New York City to achieve this distinction for four consecutive years (2022-2025).

list.title: U.S. News & World Report:
list.snippet: Frequently recognized in the top 50 nationally for various specialties, including cardiology and heart surgery, diabetes and endocrinology, and more.

list.title: Newsweek:

list.title: Regional Powerhouse:

list.title: Cardiology/Heart Surgery:
list.snippet: Consistently ranked highly, including being ranked 15th nationally in one recent ranking.

list.title: Orthopedics:
list.snippet: Also consistently ranked, with a 17th national ranking in one assessment.

list.title: Neurosurgery:
list.snippet: A renowned department with expertise in cerebral revascularization and cerebral aneurysms.

list.title: Other Top Specialties:
list.snippet: Geriatrics, Pulmonology/Lung Surgery, Ear, Nose, and Throat, Diabetes/Endocrinology, and Cancer are among other areas where Lenox Hill excels.
